body: Natalia Bryant, the 23-year-old eldest daughter of Kobe and Vanessa Bryant, made her Victoria’s Secret Fashion Show debut on October 18, 2026, walking in the PINK segment in the Los Angeles area. Having previously modeled for Versace, Boss and Off-White and appeared in a 2024 PINK campaign, Natalia celebrated another milestone in her growing fashion career—with her mother Vanessa watching from the front row. 🏽🏽.
